# Clair Donnell

## Appearance

Clair Donnell is a character noted for having a freckled face. Another character actively attempts to keep others from making comments about these freckles, remembering what it was like to have them.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P3](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0003)_

## Personality

Clair Donnell is a patriotic individual who stands firmly by their love for country. They are also characterized as lacking a great deal of tact and imagination.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P13](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0013), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)_

## History

Clair Donnell attended school in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), where his mother urged him to become a college professor. His mother also visited the school's teacher, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), to demand specific pronunciations and names for her children. In his schoolwork, Clair wrote a composition about how he intended to spend his upcoming [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) vacation.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P2](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0002), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P14](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0014), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P15](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0015), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P16](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0016), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P17](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0017), +81 more_

## Quotes

> "and I have come in to see you about something Clarice Almira told me when she came home to dinner today. It annoyed me excessively."
>
> — Clair Donnell — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013)

> "Clarice Almira told me that you pronounced our name Donnell. Now, Miss Shirley, the correct pronunciation of our name is Donnell . . . accent on the last syllable. I hope you’ll remember this in future."
>
> — Clair Donnell — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P15](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0015)

> "Certainly it is. And Clarice Almira also informed me that you call my son Jacob."
>
> — Clair Donnell — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P17](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0017)

> "Please, miss, I had to help ma make a pudding for dinner ’cause we’re expecting company and Clarice Almira’s sick,"
>
> — Clair Donnell — [v2 XII A Jonah Day P7](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0007)

> "I am Mrs. Donnell . . . Mrs. H. B. Donnell,"
>
> — Clair Donnell — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013)
